title: Holds that should have ended
subtitle: Once a day: the holds standing longer than they should, each traced to its document, unit and take, so support can explain why a pack is held.

access.deniedTitle: No access to the daily list of holds
access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the daily list of holds grant. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

notFilled: Not filled yet: the daily fill has not run.
stale: This list is more than a day old: today's fill did not run or failed, so these are yesterday's holds.

filters.storesPlaceholder: Every store, or e.g. P001, P002

kind.SOLD_OVER_24H: A sold hold whose sale was pushed over 24 hours ago and never reached HQ.
kind.DONOR_WAITS_GI: A donor store's hold waiting for the transfer's goods issue: sold and never transferred, or the transfer failed.
kind.WAITING_OVER_1H: A hold waiting for a stock movement for over an hour.
kind.RETURN_PO_OVER_30D: A Return PO saved over 30 days ago and not issued.
kind.OUT_OVER_3D: A delivery out for delivery for more than 3 days.
kind.DELIVERED_NO_SALE: A delivery delivered with no sale.

cause.SOLD_NOT_TRANSFERRED: Sold over a day ago at the order store, and the donor's transfer never made.
cause.STANDING: The delivery is delivered and its pick still holds.
cause.ENDED_BY_SWEEP: The expiry sweep ended the pick since the last fill: delivered, never sold.
cause.UNTRACED: No picking document's ledger or unit names this take.

columnHint.store: The store whose book holds it: the donor store for a donor's hold.
columnHint.age: How long the hold has stood, from Since to the list's as-of time.
columnHint.since: What the age counts from: the sale's push, the pick, the request, the movement or the delivery's dispatch.
columnHint.firstListedAt: When a daily fill first listed it. A hold that ended leaves the list at the next fill.
columnHint.reference: What the hold waits for, as the fill could name it.

list.failedTitle: The list could not be loaded
list.failed: Something went wrong reading the list. Try again in a moment.
list.empty: No hold that should have ended.

export.doneDetail_one: {{n}} row was written to the workbook.
export.doneDetail_other: {{n}} rows were written to the workbook.
export.failedDetail: The workbook could not be written. Try again.

note.rows: One row per held unit. Sold over 24 hours lists only sales that reached Stock Visibility; a sale the till never pushed is not here. Return POs appear once DRS writes them.
note.stores: Click a store to see its held units. The Return POs over 30 days read per store here.
